records.rule: When required working data is already resident elsewhere, move the compact continuation to the data rather than pulling the data to the current runner.
Carry fabric/block/provider/generation/owner-epoch identity, not resident payload, across the execution-movement boundary.
Only an authenticated Queue Fabric durable receiver receipt can ACK the local transmission queue; XTP transport signals are insufficient.
Release the old object generation only after the destination MOVE response confirms the next generation; uncertainty retains the source.
LOCAL_PASS, loopback protection, source presence and a configured named service do not prove MU-to-MI reachability. Keep live route readiness fail-closed until authoritative field evidence exists.
